question: What was told again to the goddess and to the beloved one by the sky-movers?
premises: Something concerning the mothers was told again.
It was told by the sky-movers.
It is addressed to the goddess and to the beloved one.
inference: The sky-movers told again to the goddess and the beloved one what concerns the mothers.
uncertainties: The content told is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: Again, O goddess, O beloved one, what concerns the mothers was told by the sky-movers.
